mapper.select: SELECT sd.* FROM t_as_student_destination sd INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(id) AS max_id FROM t_as_student_destination WHERE is_valid = 1 and student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY student_id ) sd_max ON sd.id = sd_max.max_id WHERE sd.is_valid = 1

SELECT term.id AS termId, term.term_name AS termName, cl.id AS classId, cl.class_name AS className, g.grade_name AS gradeName, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.student_name AS studentName, s.gender, CASE s.gender WHEN 0 THEN '男' WHEN 1 THEN '女' ELSE '未知' END AS genderDesc, s.id AS studentId, sd.destination_type AS destinationType, CASE sd.destination_type WHEN 1 THEN '课程班' WHEN 2 THEN '回家' WHEN 3 THEN '培训机构' WHEN 4 THEN '其他' ELSE '未记录' END AS destinationDesc, cc.id AS courseClassId, cc.course_class_name AS courseClassName, cs.session_date AS sessionDate, cs.id AS sessionId FROM t_educl_class cl INNER JOIN t_as_student s ON s.class_id = cl.id AND s.term_id = cl.term_id AND s.is_valid = 1 AND s.register_status = 1 LEFT JOIN t_educl_term term ON term.id = cl.term_id AND term.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_educl_grade g ON cl.grade_id = g.id AND g.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sd.student_id,sd.id AS max_id, MAX(cs.session_start_date) AS max_date FROM t_as_student_destination sd INNER JOIN t_as_course_session cs ON sd.session_id = cs.id AND cs.is_valid = 1 WHERE sd.is_valid = 1 AND cs.session_start_date <= NOW() GROUP BY sd.student_id ) sd_max ON sd_max.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN t_as_student_destination sd ON sd.id = sd_max.max_id and sd.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_course_session cs ON sd.session_id = cs.id AND cs.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 WHERE cl.is_valid = 1
AND cl.id IN
#{cid}
ORDER BY cl.id ASC, s.student_no ASC
